pm_usp_csss.academic_criteria: Top 20 percentile in Class XII board examination
necessary_documents: Aadhaar Card of Student (Linked with Active Bank Account)
Annual Family Income Certificate (Issued by Tehsildar/Competent Authority ≤ ₹8 Lakhs)
College Bonafide Student Certificate & Verification Form
Student Bank Account Passbook Copy (First page with IFSC & Account No.)
pm_usp_csss.description: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.

inspire_she.benefits: ₹80,000/year (₹60,000 cash stipend + ₹20,000 summer research project mentorship grant)
inspire_she.academic_criteria: Top 1% rank in Class XII Board or JEE Advanced / NEET top rankers
necessary_documents: Class 12th Marksheet showing Top 1% rank endorsement
inspire_she.description: Department of Science & Technology (DST) initiative to attract talented youth to study Natural and Basic Sciences at the undergraduate level.

pm_scholarship_capf.scholarship_name: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS for Armed Forces & CAPF)
pm_scholarship_capf.academic_criteria: Minimum 60% marks in Class XII or Diploma
pm_scholarship_capf.official_portal: National Scholarship Portal / KSB / WARB Portal
necessary_documents: Discharge Certificate / Service Certificate of Parent in Armed Forces / CAPF
pm_scholarship_capf.description: Encourages higher technical and professional education for wards and widows of deceased/ex-service personnel of Armed Forces and CAPF.

sc_post_matric.benefits: 100% Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Monthly Maintenance Allowance + Book Grant
sc_post_matric.academic_criteria: Passed Class 12th and admitted into recognized UG course
sc_post_matric.official_portal: National Scholarship Portal & State Social Welfare Portals
necessary_documents: SC Community / Caste Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate of Current Academic Year
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (Aadhaar Seeding verification)
Hostel Stay Certificate (if residing in college hostel)
sc_post_matric.description: Centrally sponsored scheme enabling Scheduled Caste students to complete post-secondary and undergraduate education without financial hardship.

st_top_class.scholarship_name: Top Class Education Scheme for ST Students
st_top_class.benefits: Full tuition fee up to ₹2.0 Lakhs/yr + Living expense ₹3,000/mo + Books ₹5,000/yr + Computer allowance ₹45,000
st_top_class.academic_criteria: Admission into notified premier institutes (IITs, NITs, IIMs, NIFTs, etc.)
necessary_documents: JEE Main / Entrance Exam Rank Card
College Admission Letter & Fee Structure Breakdown
st_top_class.description: Provides full financial support to talented ST students pursuing studies in top recognized institutes across India.

pm_yasasvi_obc.benefits: Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Academic Allowance up to ₹1,25,000/year
pm_yasasvi_obc.academic_criteria: Passing YASASVI Entrance Test or Top ranking in Class 12th
necessary_documents: Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account Details
pm_yasasvi_obc.description: Scheme for Vibrant India for Awarding Scholarships for Knowledge to OBC and Other Categories.

minority_mcm.benefits: Course Fee Reimbursement up to ₹20,000/year + Maintenance Allowance ₹1,000/month
minority_mcm.caste_category: Minority (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
minority_mcm.academic_criteria: Minimum 50% marks in Class 12th / Previous Exam
minority_mcm.description: Provides financial aid to poor and meritorious students belonging to minority communities to pursue professional and technical UG courses.

aicte_pragati.scholarship_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
aicte_pragati.benefits: ₹50,000/year (for tuition fee, books, equipment, laptop, competitive exam fees)
aicte_pragati.academic_criteria: Admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma course or 2nd year via Lateral Entry in AICTE approved institute
necessary_documents: Parents' Single Girl Child Affidavit (if applicable)
aicte_pragati.description: Empowers female students pursuing technical education by providing financial assistance up to 10,000 girl engineers every year.

aicte_saksham.scholarship_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently Abled Students
aicte_saksham.benefits: ₹50,000/year for tuition, books, assistive devices, and laptop
aicte_saksham.academic_criteria: Specially-abled students having disability not less than 40%
necessary_documents: Disability Certificate issued by Competent Medical Authority (≥ 40% Disability)
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account Details
aicte_saksham.description: Encourages specially-abled students to pursue technical education without financial hindrances.

aicte_swanath.academic_criteria: Orphans, Wards of Armed Forces/Paramilitary martyrs, or children of parents who died due to COVID-19
necessary_documents: Death Certificate of Parents (COVID-19 death proof or Orphanage Cert / Martyr Cert)
aicte_swanath.description: Financial support to orphans, wards of martyred soldiers, and COVID-19 affected students to pursue technical degrees.

tn_first_grad.scholarship_name: Tamil Nadu First Graduate & BC/MBC/DNC Scholarship
tn_first_grad.benefits: ₹20,000 - ₹50,000/year Tuition Fee Waiver for First Graduates
tn_first_grad.academic_criteria: First person in family pursuing a graduation degree in Tamil Nadu
tn_first_grad.official_portal: Tamil Nadu e-District Portal / TN Scholarship Portal
necessary_documents: First Graduate Certificate signed by Tahsildar
Joint Declaration by Parents and Candidate
tn_first_grad.description: Waives tuition fees for first-generation college graduates admitted via single-window counseling in Tamil Nadu.

maha_dbt.scholarship_name: Maharashtra MahaDBT Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Scholarship
maha_dbt.benefits: 50% to 100% Tuition Fee & Exam Fee Reimbursement
maha_dbt.academic_criteria: Admitted through CAP round in Maharashtra
necessary_documents: Income Certificate issued by Collector / Tahsildar (≤ ₹8 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Card Linked to Bank Account
maha_dbt.description: Frees EWS and open category meritorious students in Maharashtra from heavy tuition fee burdens.

central_sector_merit.benefits: ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000/year (Full Tuition Fee + Merit Cash Award)
central_sector_merit.academic_criteria: Top 3 Rank holders in University / Department Semester Exams
necessary_documents: Official Grade Sheet / Mark Card of Previous Semesters
Department Rank Certificate signed by HOD & Dean
Bank Account Details for Direct Benefit Transfer
central_sector_merit.description: Rewards academic excellence, consistency, and top department positions with prestigious merit stipends.

tata_trust_need.benefits: 30% to 80% of total annual college tuition fees
tata_trust_need.academic_criteria: Family income under ₹5 Lakhs and good academic standing
necessary_documents: Annual Family Income Certificate / ITR of Parents
Statement of Purpose (SOP) explaining financial need
Aadhaar Card and Student Cancelled Cheque
tata_trust_need.description: Supports undergraduate students facing severe financial constraints to complete professional degrees.

sitaram_jindal.academic_criteria: Minimum 65% marks for boys, 60% for girls in qualifying exam
necessary_documents: Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Copy
sitaram_jindal.description: Long-running philanthropic scholarship providing monthly financial relief to economically underprivileged UG students.

cbse_single_girl.scholarship_name: CBSE / UGC Single Girl Child Scholarship
cbse_single_girl.academic_criteria: Single Girl Child of parents who scored 60%+ in CBSE Class X/XII
necessary_documents: Affidavit on ₹50 Stamp Paper duly attested by First Class Magistrate / SDM stating Single Girl Child status
cbse_single_girl.description: Recognizes the efforts of parents in promoting education among girls and provides monthly financial support.

national_pwd.scholarship_name: National Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
national_pwd.benefits: Tuition Fee + ₹4,000/month living allowance + ₹4,000/year book allowance + Assistive computer devices
national_pwd.academic_criteria: Benchmark disability of 40% or more validated by medical board
national_pwd.description: Comprehensive central assistance providing assistive tech, living stipends, and course fee waivers for disabled students.

inst_iit_bits_merit.scholarship_name: IIT / BITS / VIT Merit-cum-Means Institute Scholarship
inst_iit_bits_merit.academic_criteria: Minimum 8.0 CGPA and family income below institute threshold
necessary_documents: Parents' Income Tax Returns (ITR V) / Salary Slip
inst_iit_bits_merit.description: Internal institutional grants waiving tuition fees for top performing students with constrained family finances.

sai_sports_grant.scholarship_name: Sports Authority of India (SAI) & University Sports Quota Grant
sai_sports_grant.benefits: 100% Free Hostel & Sports Kit Allowance + ₹18,000 - ₹50,000/year Cash Award
sai_sports_grant.academic_criteria: Represented State / Country in National or International Championships or All-India Inter-University Tournaments
necessary_documents: National / International Sports Participation Certificates verified by Federation
Medical Fitness Certificate from Sports Doctor
sai_sports_grant.description: Supports student athletes who balance rigorous sports training alongside undergraduate academic degrees.

aicte_idea_lab.scholarship_name: Student Innovation Fellowship & AICTE IDEA Lab Grant
aicte_idea_lab.benefits: Up to ₹1,00,000 seed grant for prototype development, 3D printing, and patent filing support
aicte_idea_lab.academic_criteria: Winning National Hackathons or working on verified hardware/software innovation patent proposals
necessary_documents: Detailed Project Proposal & Prototype Design Document
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account
aicte_idea_lab.description: Fosters startup culture, prototyping, patenting, and hardware innovation among young engineering undergraduates.

commonwealth_global_ug.category_name: International Scholarships for Indian UG Students
commonwealth_global_ug.scholarship_name: Commonwealth / Global UGRAD Overseas Exchange Scholarship
commonwealth_global_ug.benefits: Full International Tuition Fee + Roundtrip Airfare + Monthly Living Allowance ($1,500/month) + Health Insurance
commonwealth_global_ug.academic_criteria: Top academic grades, TOEFL/IELTS score, and strong leadership portfolio
commonwealth_global_ug.description: Enables outstanding Indian undergraduate students to spend a semester or full degree program in top universities in the UK, USA, Germany, or New Zealand.

reliance_foundation_ug.benefits: Up to ₹2,00,000 across the duration of the undergraduate degree
reliance_foundation_ug.academic_criteria: First year UG student scoring 60%+ in 12th standard and clearing Reliance Aptitude Test
necessary_documents: Family Income Certificate / Salary Slip (Income < ₹2.5L gets preference)
reliance_foundation_ug.description: Supports up to 5,000 meritorious Indian undergraduate students annually to pursue any discipline of higher education.

hdfc_badhte_kadam.academic_criteria: Students facing personal or family financial crisis (e.g. loss of earning parent)
necessary_documents: Proof of Family Crisis (Death cert of breadwinner / Job loss letter / Medical emergency bills)
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
hdfc_badhte_kadam.description: Crisis support scholarship ensuring vulnerable students do not drop out due to sudden family hardship.

csis_loan_subsidy.benefits: 100% Interest Subsidy on Education Loans during the Moratorium Period (Course Duration + 1 Year)
csis_loan_subsidy.academic_criteria: Availing education loan from scheduled bank for professional UG degree
csis_loan_subsidy.official_portal: Canara Bank CSIS Portal / JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in)
necessary_documents: Education Loan Sanction Letter from Bank
Income Certificate issued by designated State Authority (Family Income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Card of Student and Co-borrower Parent
csis_loan_subsidy.description: Govt. of India pays full interest on education loans during the study period so low-income students bear zero interest debt until graduation.
